Hello Comrades! If you're looking for more rich worlds and interesting characters whose lives you can better (or ruin!), our next game is coming soon! Check the [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918820/Headliner_NoviNews/]Steam page [/URL] and add to wishlist :D

And the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/680980/HEADLINER]first HEADLINER[/url] is already available here for mere $2.99!

[h1][b]What if YOU controlled the News?[/b][/h1]
Short media bias adventure game about controlling the news and it’s impact on your career, society, and family.

Check out our NEXT game on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/680980/HEADLINER/]Official Steam Page![/url]

[i]Genetic engineering and civil unrest loom over Galixia. You are the Chief Curator of a local News Channel. You are the HEADLINER[/i]

[list]
[*] Multiple outcomes on different aspects of the story lead to unique endings you can share with the community
[*] Average playthrough is around 45 mins with room for replay and experimentation
[*] Curate articles and create your OWN unique bias!
[*] Stroll down the streets and watch how society changes
[*] Chat with your family about their struggles, love or hate
[*] Colorblind-friendly design considerations
[/list]

notes.title: KARASKI at VALA Art Exhibit in Redmond, WA
notes.notes:
I just got back from opening reception of VALA Game On! The Art of Game Design, where KARASKI was on display. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11905636/923c0595af70fd6969b9171cdb6bd236bccc6c30.jpg[/img]

To be frank, I am still in denial. Karaski was, sadly, a commercial flop, which fueled much of my disappointment and impostor syndrome. Having the game featured at an art exhibit, and hearing all the nice words the curators said about it, comes with a hefty dose of disbelief. 

But hey, what do I know, you be the judge!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11905636/d7a38b48f5da4a7a5104310db13b41f038bf1fd2.jpg[/img]

If you happen to be in the Washington state this month, why not swing by and check it out? The exhibit is open June 8-30 at VALA Art Center in Redmond Town Center, 7525 166th Ave NE, Redmond, WA. [url=http://valaeastside.org/index.php/portfolio/game_on/]Here's the official webpage. [/url]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11905636/c0736d766dd9378c795215bc9ede52ed8e68e5f9.jpg[/img]
